record_type: tool-derived summary, not a raw execution log

checks.observed_result: New regression tests initially could not compile because newPostgresCommand, postgresPath, and requirePostgresASCIIPath did not exist. This compile failure is not the behavioral red evidence.

Against a command helper preserving existing behavior, TestPostgresWindowsUnicodeCommand failed because the executable path still contained Korean Unicode; TestPostgresWindowsRejectsUnicodeWithoutShortNames failed because no actionable unsupported-path error existed.

primary_sources.evidence: make_absolute_path calls getcwd when resolving relative paths; relative-only arguments cannot prevent narrow Windows current-directory conversion.
GetShortPathNameW can succeed while returning the unchanged long path when no short name exists. The implementation therefore validates ASCII output rather than trusting API success.
GetModuleFileName returns the path format used when loading the executable, including short-path form.

hosted_ci_reported_by_coordinator.before_observed_by_coordinator: TestPortableCLIEndToEnd failed on English Windows because initdb could not open a narrowed Korean Unicode password-file path.
hosted_ci_reported_by_coordinator.after_reported_by_coordinator: All three target jobs, including English Windows, succeeded.

limitations: Local host uses Korean Windows; this worker did not change the system locale or emulate English ACP.
This worker did not run the installed real PostgreSQL lifecycle; integrated installed E2E and hosted CI were owned by the coordinator.
Unicode paths require an existing usable ASCII 8.3 alias; no system setting is changed. ASCII paths do not require 8.3 support.
The raw tool output was observed but not redirected to files. This receipt summarizes those observations and does not reconstruct raw logs.
